zones.rule: Ignore any ant or detection whose box centre is inside this circle. Ants are counted only once they have left the clump at the nest opening (decided by Can, 2026-10-11).
zones.how_chosen: Clump centre from the model's detections on 10 test tiles (x 1777-1805, y 418-440); the clump fits within about 30 px; 50 px adds clearance of about 2 ant lengths.
